test_ctc_criterion: test the CTC criterion by composing a CTC graph with emissions and computing forward score loss
test_asg_criterion: test the ASG criterion by composing emissions with transitions and computing forward score loss
test_asg_viterbi_path: test the ASG Viterbi path by composing emissions with transitions and extracting the best path labels
create_emissions_graph: create a linear graph from an emissions vector with configurable time steps and num classes
create_ctc_graph: create a CTC graph from a target sequence and blank label for connectionist temporal classification
